_comment: The harness size budget (Round 3 / W7, ADR-H288). The TOTAL is the binding constraint; the per-module ratchet lives in python/tests/test_size_budget.py. Raising a ceiling is allowed but must be a deliberate edit to this file - the point is that growth cannot happen silently. Re-pinned on 2026-11-05 to the measured tree after Phase 22 / S1 (project memory), S2 (build sessions), S3 (maintenance), S4 (land pipeline) and S6 (the self-build scorecard + landing markers). Re-pinned again the same day for the deterministic quant protocol (`python/harness/quant_intent.py`, a new capability; graph.py itself stayed at its ratchet). Re-pinned again for the composer's Choices mode (`python/harness/choices_mode.py`, a new prompt-block module + the graph.py seam). These ceilings are the measured values, not padding; the ratchet resumes from here.
